info.title: GusVoice Bot API
info.description: HTTP API for GusVoice bots (Telegram-style). Every method is `POST /api/bot/v1/<method>` with the header `Authorization: Bot <token>`; the answer is `{ "ok": true, "result": … }` or `{ "ok": false, "error_code", "description", "retry_after"? }`. v1 changes only by additions: new fields, methods and events may appear — ignore what you do not know. Check `getMe.api_version` and `getMe.features` for what this server supports. Parameters may be sent as JSON, as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, or as a query string with `GET` (method names are case-insensitive). In a form or a query string booleans and integers are accepted as strings (`"true"`/`"1"`, `"5"`), arrays and objects (`reply_markup`, `embeds`, `commands`, …) — as JSON strings.

servers.description: Relative to the instance that served this document; for a saved copy use the `apiUrl` of your instance (from `/config.json`) + `/api`.

post.description: Long polling: the request is held up to `timeout` seconds (at most 50).

files[0].description: Files: fields `files[0]` … (or `file`, `file1` …), at most 10 files, each up to 26214400 bytes. Other fields are strings; `embeds` and `reply_markup` — JSON strings. An embed image may point to an uploaded file as `attachment://<file name>`.

commands.description: Up to 100 commands; every `command` must be unique in the list.

post.summary: Delivery of updates to the bot address (setWebhook)
post.description: The server POSTs updates to the address from `setWebhook`. Verify the signature header before trusting the body: `v1 = HEX(HMAC-SHA256(key = secret_token, data = t + "." + raw request body))`, and `|now − t| ≤ 300` seconds. With `batch` the body is an array of updates. Any 2xx acknowledges the delivery.

botToken.name: Authorization
botToken.description: Value `Bot gvb_…` — the bot token after the word `Bot`.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: invalid parameters or the action is not allowed in this chat.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized: the token is missing, malformed, revoked, or the bot is disabled.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the bot has no access to this chat or the user blocked it.

NotFound.description: Not Found: unknown method, chat, or message.

Conflict.description: Conflict: a webhook is set or another consumer (getUpdates / WebSocket) took over the update queue.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: This file type is not allowed (SVG/HTML).

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests: wait `retry_after` seconds (also in the `Retry-After` header) and repeat.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before repeating the request.

BotCommandScope.description: Supported `type`: default, all_private_chats, all_group_chats; other types are rejected with 400.

InlineKeyboardButton.description: Exactly one of `callback_data` (1–64 BYTES of UTF-8, not characters) and `url` (http(s) only, no credentials in the address).

InlineKeyboardMarkup.description: At least one row, 1–8 buttons in a row, at most 100 buttons in total.
